newsitem.title: USA: Matsushita U.S. president, COO retires.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita U.S. president, COO retires.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd unit Matsushita Electric Corp of America said on Thursday that Richard Kraft will retire as president and chief operating officer, with his COO duties assumed by Chairman Kunio "Kirk" Nakamura.
Kraft, whose retirement is effective April 1, will remain with the unit in the new post of executive adviser.
Matsushita Electric also said it will change the names of four of its major North American sales and service companies, replacing "Matsushita" with "Panasonic," the company's best-known brand name.
The companies affected are Matsushita Consumer Electronics Co, Matsushita Home and Commercial Products Co, Matsushita Services Co and Matsushita Electric of Canada Ltd.
